items.problem: UWP Application.Suspending / Application.Resuming events do not exist on WinUI 3 Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application; migrated code that copies them fails with CS1061.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turns 79-97: CS1061 'Application' does not contain a definition for 'Suspending'/'Resuming' across Scenario1_ConnectDisconnect.xaml.cs and EventHandlerForDevice.cs; agent fixed by deleting subscriptions and changing SuspendingEventArgs to object.
items.root_cause: The lifecycle anchor (MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md id=lifecycle) documents OnLaunched/activation replacement but never states that the Suspending/Resuming events were removed, nor how to adapt code that used them.
items.proposed_fix: Add a short 'Removed lifecycle events' note under the #lifecycle anchor: Application.Suspending/Resuming (and SuspendingEventArgs) do not exist in WinUI 3 desktop; delete the subscriptions and change handler signatures to (object sender, object args); a desktop app is not OS-suspended so the throttling logic is inert. Mention AppInstance/Window Closed as the nearest equivalents for cleanup.
items.generalizes: Suspend/resume resource management is a standard UWP idiom (device, file, media, camera handles). Any UWP→WinUI 3 migration that touches EventHandlerForDevice-style code or app-lifecycle cleanup hits this exact CS1061.

items.problem: Custom styles referenced via {StaticResource} but defined only in a SharedContent Styles.xaml that is never merged into the migrated app cause a clean build but a startup XamlParseException ('Cannot find a Resource'), surfacing as native crash 0xC000027B.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turns 109-118: Validate smoke-launch FAIL 0xc000027b; winapp run --debug-output reported Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Markup.XamlParseException 'Cannot find a Resource with the Name/Key SampleHeaderTextStyle'; agent fixed by copying SampleHeaderTextStyle/TagLine/Copyright/Separator/Hyperlink styles from SharedContent/xaml/Styles.xaml into App.xaml.
items.skill_search: grep 'SharedContent|Styles.xaml|StaticResource|MergedDictionaries|Cannot find a Resource' in winui-uwp-migration
items.root_cause: The resources section (id ~ 'Resource references') covers dangling SYSTEM brush keys that fail at COMPILE time with WMC9999, but not the distinct case of a missing CUSTOM shared-content style that resolves at build and throws at RUNTIME because its ResourceDictionary was never merged.
items.proposed_fix: Add a runtime failure-mode note to the resources section: a {StaticResource CustomKey} that names a style from a shared Styles.xaml (SharedContent) which was not merged into App.xaml builds clean but throws XamlParseException 'Cannot find a Resource' at first navigation (often a native 0xC000027B). Fix: merge the shared ResourceDictionary or copy the referenced style definitions into Application.Resources. Cross-link the startup-crashes anchor.
items.generalizes: The Windows-universal-samples family (and most multi-scenario UWP apps) share a SharedContent/xaml/Styles.xaml. Every such migration references keys like SampleHeaderTextStyle; unless the dictionary is merged, they all crash identically at startup with a build that looked green.
